Kotlin Multiplatform native D-Bus project.

Layout: `src/commonMain/kotlin` shared API/serialization; `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop` Linux native/C interop; `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}` tests/fixtures; `codegen/` JVM XML-to-Kotlin CLI/library; `plugin/` Gradle plugin `com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin` over `:codegen`; `compile_test/` compile-time integration; `samples/bluez-scan/` example.

Use root Gradle wrapper:
`./gradlew build`
`./gradlew test`
`./gradlew ktlintCheck`
`./gradlew licenseCheck`
`./gradlew dokkaHtml`
`./gradlew codegen:fatJar`

Docs output: `build/dokka`. CI release/docs run `gradle publish codegen:fatJar` and `gradle dokkaHtml` on Ubuntu.

Follow `.editorconfig`: 4 spaces, LF, max 100 columns. `ktlint` uses `android_studio`. Naming: `UpperCamelCase` classes, `lowerCamelCase` functions/properties, packages under `com.monkopedia.sdbus`. Keep public API changes intentional; `apiValidation` enforces binary compatibility. Tests: `src/nativeTest`, `codegen/src/test/kotlin`, `plugin` tests; use descriptive names such as `createsProxyFromXml`.

Run `./gradlew test` before PRs; include integration coverage when touching transport/in
